title: MintEval: Do LLMs Implement the Trading Strategy You Asked For? A Behavioural-Equivalence Benchmark for Natural-Language-to-Strategy Code
title_zh: MintEval：大型语言模型是否实现了你所要求的交易策略？——一种从自然语言到策略代码的行为等效性基准测试

paragraphs.en: Large language models are moving from producing trading signals to writing the code that executes them. The failure mode of the second role is silent: generated code runs, a backtest plots, yet the risk logic that the trader described is not the logic being executed. Existing code benchmarks test functional correctness on unit tests and finance benchmarks test forecasting; neither measures whether an implementation behaves like the strategy that was asked for. We introduce MintEval, a benchmark in which reference strategies are generated programmatically from a library of composable building blocks, back-translated into colloquial trader instructions, and re-implemented by the model under test. Generated and reference programs are executed bar by bar on identical market data and frictions, and compared on their actions rather than on code similarity or profit: alpha is differenced away. MintEval v0 contains 800 tasks on BTCUSDT 15-minute data, stratified by an execution-measured state-span complexity τ \tau that is decoupled from description length. Low-cost models reach a mean ActionMatch of at most 0.544 and reproduce at most 0.087 of tasks exactly; on a stratified subset of 200 tasks a frontier model (Claude Opus 5.5) reaches 0.889 and reproduces 0.575 exactly, yet still fails silently on 0.275 of tasks. Given a menu of building blocks, models identify the strategy almost perfectly, yet 0.792 of the implementations whose specification was read correctly diverge on more than 10% of active bars. The LLM judge of a recent strategy-generation benchmark, applied verbatim, accepts every one of these silent failures.
paragraphs.zh: 大型语言模型正从生成交易信号转向编写执行这些信号的代码。 第二种角色的失败模式是静默的：生成的代码会运行，回测图表也会绘制出来，但交易员所描述的风险逻辑却并未被实际执行。 现有的代码基准测试通过单元测试检验功能正确性，金融基准测试则检验预测能力；但两者均未衡量实现结果是否与所要求的策略一致。 我们提出了 MintEval，一个基准测试：参考策略由可组合构建模块库通过编程生成，再反向翻译为交易员的口语化指令，最后由待测模型重新实现。 生成的程序与参考程序在完全相同的市场数据和摩擦条件下逐根执行，并通过其行为而非代码相似性或利润进行比较：阿尔法值被差异消除。 MintEval v0 包含基于 BTCUSDT 15 分钟数据的 800 项任务，这些任务根据通过执行度量的状态跨度复杂度 τ \tau 进行分层，该复杂度与描述长度无关。 低成本模型的平均 ActionMatch 最多仅为 0.544，且最多只能完全复现 0.087 的任务；在包含 200 项任务的分层子集中，前沿模型（Claude Opus 5.5）的 ActionMatch 达到 0.889，并能完全复现 0.575 的任务，但仍会在 0.275 的任务上静默失败。 给定一组构建模块菜单，模型几乎能完美识别出策略，但其中 0.792 的实现虽然正确读取了规格说明，却在超过 10% 的活跃K线上出现偏差。 近期一项策略生成基准测试中的 LLM 评判器若被逐字应用，会接受所有这些静默失败。

paragraphs.en: LLMs are increasingly asked not only for a market view ( 10 , 14 , 15 ) but for the code that turns a trader’s intent into orders. In that role an error is not a bad forecast but an implementation shortfall ( 11 ) between the strategy that was intended and the one that runs. Such errors are silent : the code compiles, the backtest completes and produces a plausible equity curve, and nothing signals that, say, the breakeven stop never moves or the cooldown resets every bar. Operational failures of trading code are costly ( 12 ) , and backtests are already a fragile basis for decisions ( 2 , 3 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 人们越来越要求 LLM 不仅提供市场观点（10，14，15），还要提供能将交易员意图转化为订单的代码。 在这种角色中，错误并非预测失误，而是预期策略与实际运行策略之间的执行偏差（11）。 这类错误是悄无声息的：代码能成功编译，回测也能完成并生成看似合理的权益曲线，但没有任何迹象表明，例如，止损止盈点从未移动，或冷却机制每根K线都会重置。 交易代码的运营故障代价高昂（12），而回测本身已然是决策的脆弱基础（2，3）。

paragraphs.en: Code benchmarks such as HumanEval ( 4 ) , MBPP ( 1 ) , EvalPlus ( 9 ) , DS-1000 ( 8 ) , BigCodeBench ( 17 ) and SWE-bench ( 6 ) score functional correctness against unit tests that a human wrote for a precise specification. Trading strategies differ in three ways that make that template insufficient: (i) they are stateful over thousands of steps, and the hard part is the persistent state (an entry price, a ratcheted stop, a cooldown clock); (ii) they have zero tolerance : a single mis-timed exit changes every later decision; (iii) the specification arrives as colloquial, jargon-laden language, not as a docstring.
paragraphs.zh: 像 HumanEval (4)、MBPP (1)、EvalPlus (9)、DS-1000 (8)、BigCodeBench (17) 和 SWE-bench (6) 这样的代码基准，通过人类为明确规范编写的单元测试来评估功能正确性。 交易策略在三个方面存在差异，这使得该模板不够用：(i) 它们在数千个步骤中保持状态，而关键部分在于持续的状态（如入场价格、阶梯式止损单、冷却计时器）；(ii) 它们具有零容忍特性：一次时机不当的退出就会改变之后所有的决策；(iii) 其规范是以口语化且充满行话的语言呈现的，而不是以文档字符串的形式。

paragraphs.en: A task s s consists of a reference program c s c_{s} , a colloquial instruction q s q_{s} and fixed market data D D with frictions F F . The model under test receives q s q_{s} and an interface document (engine semantics, the indicator library, and desk conventions such as “entry price is the close of the signal bar”) and returns c ^ s \hat{c}_{s} . Both programs implement strategy(hist, state, pos, ind) , are called at every bar close, and return a target position in [ − 1 , 1 ] [-1,1] plus optional stop and take-profit levels for the next bar. We call c ^ s \hat{c}_{s} behaviourally equivalent to c s c_{s} on ( D , F ) (D,F) if their quantised target sequences coincide on every bar. Equivalence is a property of behaviour, not of code: two programs with different structure are equivalent if they act identically, and two programs that differ by one comparison operator are not.
paragraphs.zh: 一项任务 s s 包含一个参考程序 c s c_{s}、一条口语化指令 q s q_{s} 以及带有摩擦项 F F 的固定市场数据 D D。 待测试模型接收 q s q_{s} 和一份接口文档（引擎语义、指标库以及交易台惯例，例如“入场价是信号K线的收盘价”），并返回 c ^ s \hat{c}_{s}。 两个程序都实现了 strategy(hist, state, pos, ind) 策略，在每一根K线收盘时被调用，并返回一个位于 [−1, 1] 的目标头寸，以及下一根K线的可选止损和止盈水平。 如果它们在 (D, F) 上的量化目标序列在每一根K线都完全一致，我们就称 c ^ s \hat{c}_{s} 与 c s c_{s} 在行为上是等价的。 等价性是行为层面的属性，而非代码层面的属性：两个结构不同的程序如果行为完全相同，则是等价的；而仅因一个比较运算符不同而有所区别的程序则不等价。

paragraphs.en: ActionMatch (primary) is the fraction of active bars on which the two quantised targets are equal, where a bar is active if either program holds or targets a non-zero position. Restricting to active bars matters: flat periods are trivially matched and would otherwise inflate every score. TradeF1 matches round trips exactly (direction, entry bar, exit bar). | ES | |\mathrm{ES}| is the absolute difference in total return in basis points of initial equity; we take the absolute value because an implementation error that happens to make money is still an error, and signed errors would cancel across tasks. We also report Δ \Delta Sharpe and Δ \Delta MaxDD. A run that raises, times out or looks ahead is CompileOK = 0 =0 ; its other metrics are left missing rather than imputed. In the closed setting, SpecMatch scores the model’s structured reading of q s q_{s} slot by slot. A silent failure is a run with CompileOK = 1 =1 and ActionMatch < 0.9 <0.9 . The threshold is a convention, not a cliff: at 0.8 the silent share ranges from 0.370 to 0.741 across models and settings, and at 0.99 from 0.372 to 0.884 (GPT-5.4-mini open: 0.655 at 0.8, 0.729 at 0.9, 0.840 at 0.99).

paragraphs.en: Selection. paragraphs.en: Why losing references do not undermine the measurement. The median reference program loses -35.1% over the two years and only 8.9% are profitable after costs. This is friction, not a negative edge: re-running the same programs with zero fees and slippage gives a median of -0.6% with 47.8% profitable, i.e. randomly assembled rules with no edge that trade frequently at 6 bp per fill. The measurement does not depend on the sign of P&L: ActionMatch and TradeF1 compare actions, and | | ES | | compares two programs under identical frictions, so a faithful re-implementation of a losing strategy scores perfectly and an unfaithful one does not. Empirically, ActionMatch is only weakly related to reference return, and in the direction opposite to the concern: references that lose more are slightly easier to match (-0.11 ActionMatch per 100% of return, open setting, p = 3 ​ e − 05 p=3e-05 ), and the τ \tau coefficient is unchanged when R bench R_{\text{bench}} is added as a control (-0.063 open, -0.086 closed, vs. -0.065 and -0.088 without it). A benchmark whose references are realistic trading candidates is nevertheless more convincing for a finance audience; v1 lowers frictions to 2–3 bp and adds 1-hour bars so that the reference return distribution straddles zero.
paragraphs.zh: 为何亏损的参考策略不会削弱该测量结果。 参考策略的中位数在两年内亏损了 -35.1%，扣除成本后仅有 8.9% 实现盈利。 这是摩擦成本，而非负面优势：以零费用和滑点重新运行相同策略，中位数为 -0.6%，其中 47.8% 实现盈利；也就是说，没有任何优势、每笔交易以 6 个基点频率交易的随机组合规则也达到了这一结果。 该测量结果不依赖于损益（P&L）的正负：ActionMatch 和 TradeF1 比较的是操作行为，而 | | ES | | 则是在相同摩擦条件下比较两个策略，因此对亏损策略的忠实重新实现会获得完美得分，而非忠实实现则不会。 从实证角度看，ActionMatch 与参考回报的相关性仅较弱，且方向与担忧相反：亏损越多的参考策略反而略微更容易被匹配（每 100% 回报对应 -0.11 的 ActionMatch，开放设置下 p = 3 ​ e − 05 p=3e-05），而当将 R bench R_{\text{bench}} 作为控制变量加入时，τ \tau 系数保持不变（开放设置下为 -0.063，封闭设置下为 -0.086，而无需该变量时分别为 -0.065 和 -0.088）。 然而，一个参考策略均为现实交易候选标的的基准，对金融领域的受众更具说服力；v1 将摩擦成本降至 2–3 个基点，并加入了 1 小时 K 线，使参考回报的分布围绕零值展开。

paragraphs.en: Back-translation. An LLM translator (a third vendor, not among the models under test) rewrites each program, given its precise template description and source, as a 40–120 word desk message in one of eight rotating voices. Deterministic gates require every parameter value to appear, at least three expressions from a slang dictionary (drafted with LLM help, under human review), no code-like tokens, and the conventional phrasing for formula-level rules; failures are fed back for up to six attempts. A round-trip reader from a fourth vendor then recovers the block-level spec from the message; a mismatch is fed back as well. 796 of 800 messages pass all gates (780 round-trip verified, 20 unverifiable because the reader failed); median length 96 words with 11 slang hits. The reader sees the block menu, so it verifies identification rather than sufficiency; two ambiguities it missed during calibration were resolved with explicit desk conventions (§ 7 ).
paragraphs.zh: 反向翻译。 一家大型语言模型（LLM）翻译器（由第三方供应商提供，不属于测试模型之列）会根据精确的模板描述和源代码，将每个程序改写为一段 40–120 字的桌面消息，并使用八种轮替使用的语气之一。 确定性门控要求每个参数值都必须出现，且必须包含至少三个来自俚语词典的表达（该词典在人类审核下由 LLM 协助起草），不得包含任何类代码的标记，并需使用公式级规则的标准措辞；若出现失败，系统会反馈错误，最多允许六次尝试。 随后，第四家供应商提供的往返读取器会从消息中恢复块级规范；若存在不匹配情况，也会反馈错误。在 800 条消息中，有 796 条通过了所有门控（其中 780 条通过往返验证，20 条因读取器失败而无法验证）；消息长度的中位数为 96 字，包含 11 个俚语表达。 由于读取器能看到块菜单，因此它验证的是身份识别而非充分性；在校准期间它遗漏的两个歧义问题，已通过明确的桌面规范（§ 7）得以解决。

paragraphs.en: What goes wrong. For the open-weight models, failures that raise are dominated by interface misuse (Qwen-7B indexes the history object directly), state-type violations (storing None , which the interface forbids) and look-ahead: indexing a higher-timeframe series with the 15-minute bar index (e.g. htf.close[t // 4] ), which reads the candle still in progress. In an engine without physical causality enforcement this silently leaks future data into the backtest. Silent failures we inspected include breakout levels computed over a window that contains the current bar (so the breakout can never trigger), stops re-anchored to the current close on every bar instead of to the entry, and HTF filters evaluated on the wrong candle. A systematic taxonomy is left to v1.

paragraphs.en: We apply the QuantCode-Bench judge ( 7 ) verbatim (prompt and rating parser from its public repository; temperature 0, thinking off; the judge model is Claude Sonnet 4, the default in that repository) to every compiled open-setting run of Opus 5.5 and GPT-5.4-mini on the 200-task subset, giving it our instruction q s q_{s} and the generated code.
paragraphs.zh: 我们对 Opus 5.5 和 GPT-5.4-mini 在 200 个任务的子集上运行的每一次编译后的开放设置执行，都直接应用了 QuantCode-Bench 判官（其提示词和评分解析器来自其公共仓库；温度设为 0，关闭思考模式；判官模型为 Claude Sonnet 4，即该仓库中的默认模型），并向其提供我们的指令 q s q_{s} 以及生成的代码。

paragraphs.en: The judge passes every judged run (Table 3 ): all 55 silent failures of Opus 5.5 (0.275 of its passes) and all 120 of GPT-5.4-mini (0.736 of its passes; 26 of its runs could not be judged because our API budget ran out). The judge is not simply permissive: in a negative control that pairs an instruction with code written for a different task using a different signal family, it rejected 7 of 7. It detects the wrong strategy; it cannot detect the right strategy implemented wrongly. This is the gap behavioural equivalence closes, and it applies to any evaluation whose final check reads code rather than executing it against a reference.
paragraphs.zh: 裁判器通过了所有经过判断的运行（表3）：Opus 5.5 的全部 55 次静默失败（占其通过率的 0.275），以及 GPT-5.4-mini 的全部 120 次失败（占其通过率的 0.736；其中 26 次运行因我们的 API 预算用尽而无法判断）。 裁判器并非一味宽松：在一个负面对照实验中，它将指令与使用不同信号族为其他任务编写的代码配对，结果 7 次全部被拒绝。 它能检测出错误的策略；但无法检测出正确策略的错误实现。 这正是行为等效性所填补的差距，并且这一特性适用于任何最终检查通过读取代码而非对照参考执行代码的任何评估。

paragraphs.en: Code generation benchmarks score functional correctness on unit tests ( 4 , 1 , 9 , 8 , 17 ) or on repository tests ( 6 ) ; LiveCodeBench addresses contamination by collecting problems after model cut-offs ( 5 ) . MintEval instead generates tasks combinatorially and judges behaviour over thousands of stateful steps against a reference, which makes silent divergence measurable. Closest to our work , QuantCode-Bench ( 7 ) collects 400 real strategy descriptions (Reddit, TradingView, StackExchange, GitHub) and checks generated Backtrader code for compilation, backtest execution, the presence of trades, and semantic alignment judged by an LLM; the best models reach 70–76% judge pass in a single turn and 95–98% with iterative repair. Its tasks are real and its model coverage broad, both stronger than ours. The two benchmarks answer complementary questions: QuantCode-Bench asks whether a model can produce an executable strategy that plausibly matches a real description; MintEval asks whether the produced strategy behaves as described, which requires a reference program and lets us vary the mechanism. In their pooled single-turn breakdown only 2.7% of attempts are rejected by the judge; a code-reading judge cannot observe a trailing stop that is re-anchored every bar. We measure this gap directly in Section 5 . Code hallucination studies catalogue incorrect but plausible code ( 13 , 16 ) ; we quantify one consequential form of it. LLMs in finance have been studied mainly as forecasters and domain language models ( 10 , 14 , 15 ) . Our metric borrows the logic of implementation shortfall ( 11 ) : the gap between the intended and the executed strategy, with alpha differenced away. Backtest overfitting ( 2 , 3 ) and operational failures ( 12 ) motivate treating implementation fidelity as a first-class risk.

sents.en: Code generation benchmarks score functional correctness on unit tests ( 4 , 1 , 9 , 8 , 17 ) or on repository tests ( 6 ) ; LiveCodeBench addresses contamination by collecting problems after model cut-offs ( 5 ) .

sents.en: MintEval instead generates tasks combinatorially and judges behaviour over thousands of stateful steps against a reference, which makes silent divergence measurable.

paragraphs.en: MintEval is a diagnostic benchmark: controlled generation lets us vary τ \tau , K K and block type independently, which a benchmark of naturally occurring tasks cannot do, but it does not sample the distribution of real strategies. A real subset (strategies ported from open-source frameworks and exchange product specifications, with human-written intents and human-verified reference ports) is under construction; its role is to test whether model rankings and the τ \tau effect transfer. v0 is small: one instrument (BTCUSDT), one data window, 800 tasks and four models with one sample each. A human baseline and a human-rewritten instruction subset are in progress; until then, instructions are LLM-written and may be friendlier to LLMs than real traders’ messages, and the slang dictionary is still under human review. Latency is deliberately excluded: fidelity and latency are orthogonal goals. The unit of observation is the bar-level action and the complete round trip; we do not model intra-position dynamics such as fills inside a bar beyond stop/take priority. The reference library, interface document and desk conventions were written with the help of Claude Opus 5.5, the same family as our frontier model; shared conventions may favour it, and replicating the frontier result with models from other families is a priority for v1. Finally, a mismatch can stem from an ambiguous instruction rather than from the model; the round-trip reader bounds but does not eliminate this.
paragraphs.zh: MintEval 是一个诊断性基准测试：受控生成使我们能够独立地调整 τ、K 和区块类型，这是自然发生的任务基准无法做到的，但它并不会对真实策略的分布进行采样。 一个真实的子集（从开源框架和交易所产品规格中移植的策略，搭配人类编写的意图和人类验证的参考端口）正在构建中；其作用在于检验模型排名以及 τ 效应是否能够迁移。v0 的规模较小：仅包含一种交易工具（BTCUSDT）、一个数据窗口、800 项任务以及每个模型各一个样本的四种模型。 一个人类基准和一个由人类重写的指令子集正在开发中；在此之前，所有指令均由 LLM 编写，可能比真实交易者的消息更“友好”于 LLM，且俚语词典仍在接受人工审核。 延迟被有意排除在外：保真度和延迟是相互正交的目标。 观察单位是 K 线级别的动作和完整的往返过程；我们不模拟仓位内部的动态变化，例如在 K 线内超出止损/止盈优先级的成交行为。 参考库、接口文档和交易台惯例是在 Claude Opus 5.5 的帮助下编写的，它与我们的前沿模型属于同一系列；共享的惯例可能会使其更具优势，而使用其他系列的模型复现前沿结果则是 v1 的优先事项。 最后，不匹配可能源于指令本身存在歧义，而非模型问题；往返读取机制可以界定这一问题，但无法完全消除它。

paragraphs.en: MintEval evaluates implementation fidelity, not profitability; no strategy in it is investment advice, and most reference strategies lose money after costs. Market data are public (data.binance.vision). No personal data are used. Model-generated code runs in a sandbox without network or file access.
